title: Storey Architecture button
description: A hard-cornered rectangle with the label at the left and a small dashed ring at the right. On hover the label slides a hair to the right (0.2s) and the ring turns 115° (0.5s). Black, white or form-grey; a large size for heroes and a small one for inline actions, all sized in vw like the original.
notes: sizes are in vw (the original scales the whole page with the window); pass className to override
variant light is meant for photos and dark bands
